findings.impact: The preview can emit a internally consistent but scientifically or accounting-incompatible prospective gate while reporting the intended fixed identity/20 allowance. Later admission may reject it; this is not a demonstrated numerical-admission bypass.
findings.issue: Draft and prepared input bodies are not pinned to their frozen preparation. Body hashes are accepted from the same unpinned draft. Exact extracted predicates accept coherent epochs100to99, seed11to12, eager-to-selected execution changes, a removed cumulative_budget_extension, and a foreign experiment family. Source/input counts and historical12 preservation remain satisfied.

Rejoin required family, model/training/recipe/job/plan/runtime/closure/review roles, charter/runtime hashes and cumulative extension/review paths to that pinned draft.

findings.impact: A later change to the lifecycle namespace can leave the preview reporting the old spent count/highest allowance with no refusal, contrary to the stated exact preview contract. No actual lifecycle file was modified to demonstrate this static omission.
